parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$R=0.4g\cos30^\circ=2\sqrt3$, or $F$ or $\mu R=0.4g\sin30^\circ=2$ [B1; use of $m$ instead of $0.4$ condoned].

$0.4g\sin30^\circ-\mu(0.4g\cos30^\circ)=0$ [M1: use $F=\mu R$; allow sine/cosine mix; both must be different components of weight only, not a two-term $R$; allow sign errors and omitted $g$].

$\mu=\frac{4\sin30^\circ}{4\cos30^\circ}=\frac1{\sqrt3}=\frac{\sqrt3}{3}$ [A1 AG; exact answer only]. If zero scored, SC B1 for angle of friction $=30^\circ$, so $\mu=\tan30^\circ=1/\sqrt3$. Allow full marks using $m$ for $0.4$ or $W$ for $mg$ or $0.4g$. A0 for only $\mu=0.577\ldots=1/\sqrt3$, but A1(ISW) for $\mu=1/\sqrt3=0.577\ldots$. Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$7.2-0.4g\sin30^\circ-F=0.4a$ [M1: N2L with four terms; the second term must be a component of their weight; $F\ne0$ and $F\ne\mu$; allow sine/cosine mix and sign errors; $F$ must be numerical, and their $F$ from part (a) may be used].

$a=8$ [A1].

$1=0+\frac12(\text{their positive }8)t^2$ [M1: use constant-acceleration formula and solve for $t$; $a\ne\pm10,\pm g$; if their $a$ is negative, allow $|a|$ here].

Time $=0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ [A1]. Total: 4.
